rationale: All three round-4 asks are addressed at reviewed commit 0f7f2216. I independently re-derived the hard-block fixture in a fresh /tmp clone: with .beads present, two healthy active specs, and no session.json, ReadState returned a non-nil HookState with Mode indeterminate, and real Run("pre-commit", &Input{}, ReadState, true) on protected main returned Block. My final nil-route audit found exactly two reachable ReadState nil exits: workspace.FindLocalRoot failure and phase.BeadsDirMissing(root). The trailing empty-mode/no-session check is unreachable by construction because ResolveContext always returns a non-nil Context with nil error; after .beads is known present, every non-empty Phase is copied to hs.Mode and every empty Phase, including multi-active ambiguity and derivation failure, is mapped to ModeIndeterminate. The new direct and end-to-end regressions pin the required behavior, and the rewritten invariant comments match the executable paths. go build ./..., go test ./internal/hook -count=1, and go test ./... -short -count=1 passed in the reviewed bead worktree. The scratch probe clone was removed, and the bead worktree remained clean at 0f7f2216. No spec-branch-corrupting defect was found.

The focused hook suite passed, and my separate scratch-clone probe independently observed Action Block.

findings.summary: The nil-route invariant now matches the complete reachable control flow.
findings.evidence: ReadState has three syntactic nil returns. The first two are the sanctioned pre-initialization routes: no local root and missing .beads. The final check cannot fire: ResolveContext delegates to ResolveContextFromDirWithCache, which always returns its allocated non-nil Context and nil error; ReadState assigns any non-empty ctx.Phase to hs.Mode and maps any empty ctx.Phase to ModeIndeterminate while setting indeterminate=true. Thus neither conjunct combination required by the final nil check is reachable after initialization.
